The 'untitled Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes sequel' is an upcoming American science fiction action film. It is intended to be the sequel to Kingdom of the Planet of the Apes (2024), the fifth installment in the Planet of the Apes reboot film series, and the eleventh film overall.
The film is expected to be released by 20th Century Studios in 2027.
Production
Development
In June 2022, Wes Ball entered early negotiations to develop two additional Planet of the Apes films which will complete a new trilogy, and serve as sequels to the Rupert Wyatt and Matt Reeves trilogy of films. Ball confirmed this in December 2023, explaining that the film had been conceived as the beginning of a trilogy that "fit into the legacy of" the previous three films. Rick Jaffa and Amanda Silver also expressed interest in making a third trilogy of films, thus bringing the total of the Planet of the Apes reboot films to nine films. In October 2024, 20th Century president Steve Asbell revealed that a new Apes film is in development for an expected 2027 release.
Release
The untitled sequel is expected to be released in the United States in 2027.
